name: 23294 · Richmond, VA
findings: ZIP 23294 (Richmond) has 107 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23294 (Richmond) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23294 (Richmond) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
